title: Kalapam
desc: Bharathan, a communist, works for the welfare of the people. He soon faces many challenges when he encounters an evil businessman.

title: Alilakuruvikal
desc: An artist falls in love with a woman who is about to get married to someone else. Things become complicated when the woman develops feelings for the artist as well.

title: Janatha Garage
desc: When Anand visits Hyderabad, he encounters Sathyam, who operates an organisation aiding the underprivileged. Sathyam, swayed by Anand's vision, hands over the organisation's management to him.

desc: Vava, a villager, goes through many troubles as he is born to a Christian mother and a Brahmin father. However, he is determined to prove to the society that love matters the most.

title: Koushalam
desc: Gopinadhan and Mathunni steal money from the rich and distribute it amongst the needy. When Mathunni robs Maya, Gopinadhan returns it and falls in love with her.

title: Bandhukkal Sathrukkal
